mods.name: CNR Mod (Core)
mods.description: The core mod for Cops N Robbers. Redirects the game to the community LAN server, adds custom map loading, an in-game economy system, and a DLL mod loader that scans /sdcard/CNRMods/ on launch.

versions.changelog: LAN server redirect. Custom map support. Economy hook. DLL mod loader with /sdcard/CNRMods/ scanner.

mods.name: CNR Settings
mods.description: Adds a settings panel accessible from the main menu and in-game. Features draggable HUD element repositioning, ADS sensitivity slider, wide camera angle toggle, full keyboard and mouse binding support, and a player account system with PIN login.

versions.changelog: Full HUD drag-and-resize for all UI elements. KBM bindings with capture mode. ADS multiplier. Wide camera toggle (35deg / 70deg). Account PIN system.

mods.name: Mod Manager
mods.description: Browse, install, and manage DLL mods from online repositories. Tap a mod for its full description, version history, and changelogs. Supports multiple repos and works standalone even without CNR Mod installed.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Browse tab with mod list and detail pages. Version history with changelogs. latestOnly flag per mod. Multiple repo support with PlayerPrefs storage.
